'''Beckar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] of the Alliance forces in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]], and was based at the [[Trax Sector Command]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entrus]]. A tall man, he had a long scar down one side of his head. Commander Beckar authorized and masterminded the Alliance [[Battle of Bissillirus|strike]] on the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]].
